question: The Government of India launched a new programme named ‘NAVYA’ to provide vocational training to adolescent girls in non-traditional job roles. In which district was this programme first launched in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonbhadra, Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **NAVYA** programme is a strategic initiative launched by the **Government of India** to empower **adolescent girls** by providing them with specialized **vocational training**.
 
• The programme was first inaugurated in **June 2025** in the **Sonbhadra district** of **Uttar Pradesh**, marking a significant step toward regional development and gender parity in the workforce.
 
• The core objective of **NAVYA** is to facilitate the entry of young women into **non-traditional job roles**, which includes sectors like **manufacturing**, **renewable energy**, **electronics**, and **information technology**.
 
• By focusing on **non-traditional roles**, the scheme aims to break long-standing **gender stereotypes** that often confine women to specific service-oriented or domestic-adjacent occupations.
 
• The training curriculum is designed to make the participants **industry-ready**, ensuring they possess the technical skills required for high-growth sectors in the modern **Indian economy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Significance of Sonbhadra:**
 
 
• **Sonbhadra** is the second-largest district of **Uttar Pradesh** and is often referred to as the **"Energy Capital of India"** due to its high concentration of power plants.
 
• Being an **Aspirational District**, it was selected for the pilot launch of **NAVYA** to boost **socio-economic indicators** among the marginalized sections of the population.
 
• The district is unique as it borders four different states: **Madhya Pradesh**, **Chhattisgarh**, **Jharkhand**, and **Bihar**, making it a critical hub for regional integration.
 
 
 
• **Target Demographic and Scope:**
 
 
• The programme primarily targets girls in the age group of **14 to 18 years**, ensuring they receive **skill development** alongside or after their formal schooling.
 
• Roles included under the training umbrella involve **Electric Vehicle (EV) technicians**, **drone pilots**, **solar panel installers**, and **industrial automation experts**.
 
• It aligns with the broader goals of the **National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC)** and the **Skill India Mission**.
 
 
 
• **Policy Alignment:**
 
 
• **NAVYA** complements existing schemes like **Beti Bachao Beti Padhao** by moving beyond education to **economic self-reliance**.
 
• It follows the guidelines of the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**, which emphasizes the **vocationalization of education** from an early stage.
 
• The **Ministry of Women and Child Development**, in collaboration with the **Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship**, monitors the implementation to ensure quality and placement support.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Economic Impact:** By integrating women into the **industrial workforce**, the **NAVYA** programme is expected to contribute to an increase in the **Female Labour Force Participation Rate (FLFPR)** in **India**.
 
• **Social Transformation:** Training in **non-traditional trades** provides girls with higher **bargaining power** within their families and communities, delaying early marriage and promoting **financial independence**.
 
• **Technological Integration:** The **2025** launch highlights the government's focus on **Industry 4.0**, where skills in **coding**, **robotics**, and **AI-driven logistics** are becoming essential.
